name: SpicetifyFM (Last.fm Scrobbler)
description: A pure in-app Last.fm scrobbler inspired by Pano Scrobbler — zero third-party apps or external servers required. Features serverless Desktop Web Auth, Playbar status pill with personal track scrobble counts, saved per-track metadata edits, Regex & Remastered/Deluxe cleaners, artist/track blocklists, Local Files support, and an offline retry queue.
